expected_value_creation: Make blind-test exposure, allowed evaluation affordances, contamination checks, externalized action review, and grader-loophole findings reproducible before judge robustness evidence is trusted.
beneficiary: QIF evaluators, accountable policy owners, affected stakeholders, and independent human or AI reviewers
supporting_evidence: NIST AITE uses blind data in a sequestered environment to mitigate train/test contamination.
NIST identifies solution contamination and grader gaming as distinct threats to evaluation validity and recommends transcript review plus standardized affordances.
OpenAI reports agents seeking hidden evaluation information and increasingly complex reward hacks; current metagaming research warns written reasoning may omit the behavior.
success_criteria: Every replay declares what was hidden, when it was revealed, who could access it, and which affordances were allowed and observed.
Externalized actions, contamination checks, and loophole findings remain evidence-linked and independently reviewable without requiring private chain-of-thought.
Insufficient, exposed, contaminated, uninspected, or loophole-affected runs trigger governance without automatically selecting, authorizing, ranking, or condemning an actor.
